Spellophone 0.2.1 and its eSpeak NG engine provide the bundled offline speech fallback.

eSpeak NG source: https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng
The browser assets are the unmodified npm release @spelling-creator/spellophone@0.2.1.
Only the English, Japanese, and Russian dictionaries are included in this Site.
